items.name: mantle-errors
items.title: Mantle form errors
items.description: Maps @mantlejs/client errors onto React Aria form state: Unprocessable field errors to fields, everything else to a form-level message.

items.name: auth-provider
items.title: Auth provider
items.description: Session state for the Mantle auth blocks: persisted-session restore, OAuth redirect handling, login/signup/logout. Exposes useAuth().

items.name: login-form
items.title: Login form
items.description: Email/password login against @mantlejs/auth-local, built on React Aria Form + TextField.

items.name: signup-form
items.title: Sign-up form
items.description: Account creation through your users service, then local login. Duplicate-email and schema errors shown inline.

items.name: oauth-buttons
items.title: OAuth buttons
items.description: Continue-with links for the seven @mantlejs/auth-* OAuth strategies (Google, GitHub, Facebook, Apple, Microsoft, LinkedIn, X).
